clips.title: The story
paras: Taming the Beast is an introductory trial where aspiring adventurers learn the art of pacifying and bonding with wild animal companions. Guided by Josephine Carson, initiates take a Taming Rod into the forest to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice essential survival skills. The task demonstrates that surviving harsh frontiers is far easier alongside a loyal beast, provided one honors and preserves the delicate balance of nature.

For many wanderers of the wilds, venturing alone through untamed territories is an invitation to danger. An animal companion provides not only fierce protection in battle, but steadfast companionship through grueling journeys. Learning how to form such a bond is a vital milestone for any aspiring hunter or tracker. Through the guidance of Josephine Carson, novices are entrusted with a specialized Taming Rod and instructed to seek out a Rockhide Boar within the forest. Calming and directing such a creature serves as a foundational trial, proving whether a traveler possesses the focus and composure required to guide a beast without succumbing to fear or provoking needless bloodshed.

Mastering wild animals carries profound ethical and ecological responsibilities. As Josephine Carson reminds her pupils, drawing beasts into service must never degenerate into reckless exploitation, as the balance of nature remains fragile and must always be upheld. The taming process is not about cruelty or dominance, but about establishing harmony and discipline between beast and master. Using the enchanted rod allows a novice to safely practice handling a formidable creature like a Rockhide Boar without permanently depleting the local wildlife. Once the fundamentals of commanding and soothing the beast are achieved, the rod is returned, demonstrating that respect for the natural order comes before pride.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many adventurers prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.
Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as an adventurer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will learn, friend, and one day you will be a great adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend! You are quite a fast learner.
